name: Outdoor Voices

prices.note: Shopify collection feed /collections/leggings, Women's Leggings (20 products; 3 non-legging titles; 13 with a compare_at_price above price excluded): 4 regular-price leggings. Puddle Legging (Grass) $88; TechSweat Core 7/8 Legging $118 (Mineral Blue) and $128 (Darkbay Polka Dot, Forest). Range covers few items because most leggings were marked down.

Men's Tops collection (23 products): 3 regular-price short-sleeve tees, $38 (Everyday Classic Shortsleeve, organic cotton jersey, Blue Gum and Eucalyptus, XS–XL) to $68 (ThinkFast Mesh Shortsleeve, Granite, XXS–XL). Excluded: 9 short-sleeve tees with a compare-at price above price (e.g. Everyday Classic in Surf $26.99), 2 CloudKnit Shortsleeve colorways at $58 tagged 'SALEONSALE:…' (treated as a markdown tag, conservative), tanks and long-sleeves. Range covers few items because most men's tees were marked down. Regular price = no variant with compare_at_price above price and no markdown tag (markdown, clearance, outlet, final, DiscountApplied, sale-NN, NN%, on-sale, sale, flash-sale, further reductions); campaign-eligibility tags with no compare-at price (e.g. '10th-anniversary-sale', 'cp:SeptEOSSale', 'DISCOUNT') are not treated as markdowns. Short-sleeve tees only: long-sleeve, tanks, stringers, polos, button-ups, jerseys, sweaters, packs and box sets excluded.
